python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np

img17 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0017.png')
# At col 145, row 300 to 450:
for r in range(300, 420, 10):
    # cabinet corner right edge:
    # let's find the rightmost pixel of the cabinet at row r
    row = img17[r, 0:160, :]
    # wall is [255, 255, 255]
    non_wall = np.where(~((row[:, 0] > 240) & (row[:, 1] > 240) & (row[:, 2] > 240)))[0]
    # table leg is around col 130-140, cabinet is at lower col
    cab_cols = [c for c in non_wall if c < 150 and row[c, 0] > 30] # cabinet is brownish/tan/grey, table leg is dark brown [17, 42, 83]
    if cab_cols:
        print(f'r={r}: cab cols max = {max(cab_cols)}, color = {row[max(cab_cols)]}')
"
